gloss: to use a metaphor; to liken; to compare figuratively

definitions.gloss: to use a metaphor; to liken; to compare figuratively
definitions.explanation: To express something by comparing it to something else in a figurative way. Often used in literary criticism, rhetoric, and academic writing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{人生|じんせい}→人生：03355_jinsei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{旅|たび}→旅：03407_tabi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比喩|ひゆ}する。
examples.english: To liken life to a journey.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{機械|きかい}→機械：02366_kikai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比喩|ひゆ}して⟦{説明|せつめい}した→説明する：05639_setsumeisuru⟧。
examples.english: He explained society by likening it to a machine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比喩|ひゆ}する⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{表現|ひょうげん}→表現：03584_hyougen⟧だ。
examples.english: Comparing the passage of time to the flow of a river is an expression that has existed since ancient times.

notes:
The verb form of the noun ⟦{比喩|ひゆ}→比喩：13204_hiyu⟧ (metaphor, simile, figure of speech). The pattern is typically A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比喩|ひゆ}する (to liken A to B). More formal and literary than ⟦{例|たと}える→例える：10365_tatoeru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- A⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧B⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{比喩|ひゆ}する: to liken A to B
- {比喩|ひゆ}して⟦{言|い}えば→言う：00515_iu⟧: speaking metaphorically
- {比喩|ひゆ}される: to be compared to (passive)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{例|たと}える→例える：10365_tatoeru⟧: to compare, to liken — more common in everyday speech
- {喩|たと}える: variant kanji of the above, literary
- ⟦なぞらえる→なぞらえる：10610_nazoraeru⟧: to compare, to liken — literary, often implies modeling after something
